statement.zh: Norte Chico 晚古风大型遗址群以纪念性建筑、广泛居住建筑与无陶为共性，测年总框约 3000–1800 cal BCE。
statement.en: Norte Chico Late Archaic large sites share monumental architecture, extensive residential architecture, and aceramic assemblages, framed ~3000–1800 cal BCE.

editorial.notes: Derived only from civ MD + registered sources. No new archaeological inventions.
